_about: 2-Propanol (1) + Isopropyl acetate (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.32 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 2-propanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 2-propanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).
